16th October 19 20

REPORT Daily Report.

Made by D. I. Givens Forwarded by a/. Director of Criminal Intelligence.

Sir,

The members of the Lecturing Groups of the National Citizens' Convention Organization held a meeting in its head-quarters, No. 10 Ningpo Road, the Cantonese Guild, at 5 p.m. yesterday, 15th instant, when the following decisions were passed :-

1 - That one lecture at least be delivered before each asso-ciation which has joined the National Citizens' Convention Organization, and that due notice be sent to the societies of the day on which the lecture is to be given.

2 - That the notes for these lectures be submitted to the President of the Lecturing Groups for approval.

3 - That reports by the lecturing parties on the progress of their work be made from time to time to the Committee.

The meeting which was presided over by Sun Dao Shun (孙道胜) a prominent member of the National Salvation "Ten Men Group" Society, whose headquarters are at No. 47 Rue Soongchan, French Concession, terminated at 7 p.m.

The members of the National Organizations' Union of China held a meeting in their headquarters at No. 371 Rue Amiral Bayle, at 3 p.m. 15th instant, and decided to press the Central Government to abolish the Tuchun system. Mr. Yao Tsoh Ping (姚作賓), a returned student from Japan, presided. The meeting terminated at 5 p.m.

由 D. I. Givens 编制，经代理刑事情报处处长转呈。

先生：

国民大会组织宣讲团成员于昨日（即本月15日）下午5时在该会总部宁波路10号广东会馆举行会议，通过如下决议：

1 - 凡加入国民大会组织的各协会，至少应向其举办一次讲座，并应提前通知各社团讲座举行的日期。

2 - 这些讲座的讲稿须提交宣讲团团长批准。

3 - 宣讲人员应不时向委员会报告工作进展。

会议由“救国十人团”著名成员孙道胜主持，该团总部设在法租界宋园路47号。会议于下午7时结束。

中华全国各界联合会成员于本月15日下午3时在其总部贝勒路371号举行会议，决定敦促中央政府废除督军制度。会议由留日学生姚作賓主持。会议于下午5时结束。

15th October 1920
Daily Report.
Made by D. I. Givens Forwarded by
Sir,
From enquiries made at Loonghwa, it appears certain that Li Shun, the late Tuchun of Kiangsu, committed suicide by shooting himself, the following causes being advanced for his rash act :-
(1) Li, who was very anxious for internal peace, had endeavoured during the past few years to effect a compromise between the North and South. Although his nomination as Chief of Northern Peace Delegation would appear to increase his power to give effect to his desires, the general complicated situation of the country prevented him from making progress in this direction and this must have had a very depressing effect on his spirits.
(2) Li was distressed at the behaviour of Chang Tso Ling, the Tuchun of Fengtien and Inspector General of the three Eastern Provinces, who, taking advantage of the recent victory of the Chihli Party, established his influence in Peking, and dismissed some of Li's friends from office.
(3) The Tuchun of Kiangse, a former great friend of Li Shun, protested against the latter's appointment as Inspector General of Kiangsu, Anhui and Kiangse, and it is known that this disturbed Li very much.
(4) Lately Li Shun made a recommendation to the Central Government that Wen Oo (文翁禾), his alleged adopted son, be appointed provincial treasurer of Kiangsu. 由 D. I. Givens 编制，经
先生：

据在龙华进行的查询，江苏前督军李纯确系开枪自杀，其轻生之举的原因如下：

(1) 李纯非常渴望内部和平，在过去几年中一直努力促成南北妥协。虽然他被任命为北方和平代表团团长似乎增加了他实现愿望的权力，但国家总体复杂的局势阻碍了他在此方面的进展，这必然对他的情绪产生了极大的压抑影响。

(2) 李纯对奉天督军兼东三省巡阅使张作霖的行为感到苦恼，张作霖利用直系最近的胜利，在北京建立了自己的势力，并罢免了李纯的一些朋友。

(3) 江西督军曾是李纯的挚友，他对李纯被任命为江苏、安徽和江西巡阅使表示抗议，众所周知，此事令李纯非常不安。

(4) 最近李纯向中央政府推荐其养子文翁禾（音译）担任江苏省财政厅厅长。各地公共团体对此举动提出抗议，指责李纯意图向江苏人民勒索钱财。这种对其意图的误解

General Zee Sih Yuen(齊燮元), the Commander of 6th
Division of the Northern Army, is now acting as Tuchun of
Kiangsu. It is probable that either General Lu Yung Ziang,
the Tuchun of Chekiang, or General Tsao Kun, the Tuchun of
Chihli, will be appointed Li Shun's successor. The name of
General Wu Pei Fu, the Commander of the 3rd Division of the
Northern Army, is also mentioned as a likely candidate.
The rumours current that Li Shun was murdered seem to
have been fabricated by some of the Defence Commissioners in
this province who are opposed to General Zee Sih Yuen. The
latter holds the military power in Nanking and it has been
stated that he may be appointed to the Tuchunship. The parties
mentioned are anxious to prevent this and have started rumours
to discredit him.
The people in this province are seeking to use Li Shun's
unnatural death as a lever to press their demand for the aboli-
tion of the Tuchun system, but the Central Government does not
seem inclined to make any changes in this respect while the
present political unrest continues.
The Military Governor here has not received any news of
any unusual happenings in Peking where everything appears to
be quiet.

给李纯带来了巨大的悲痛。
北洋陆军第六师师长齐燮元将军现任江苏代理督军。浙江督军卢永祥将军或直隶督军曹锟将军可能会被任命为李纯的继任者。北洋陆军第三师师长吴佩孚将军的名字也被提及为可能的候选人。
目前流传的李纯被谋杀的谣言，似乎是由本省一些反对齐燮元将军的防卫委员捏造的。后者掌握着南京的军事权力，据说他可能被任命为督军。上述各方急于阻止此事，因此散布谣言以破坏他的声誉。
本省民众正试图利用李纯的非正常死亡作为杠杆，迫使他们要求废除督军制度，但在目前的政治动荡持续期间，中央政府似乎不打算在这方面做出任何改变。
本处的淞沪护军使未收到北京发生任何异常事件的消息，那里一切似乎都很平静。

being one year but can be re-elected. The members
of the staff may be employed by the committee.

Settlement for the past five years and paying a
municipal rate of more than $50.00 and a house rent

Shangae - 13-10'00.

The Woosung and Shanghai Constabulary
have issued a notification to the following effect:-
"In view of the fact that the foreign bars
on North Szechuen Road and Jukong Road are continua-
lly committing breaches of Police Regulations, I,
Chief of Police, drew up nine conditions for the
control of the establishments. The conditions
are printed in English and Chinese and copies of
same were distributed to the bars.
I have now found that some of the bars carry
on their business according to the conditions,
whilst others wilfully infringe them, such as
keeping their doors open all night and allowing
disturbances to take place. If steps are not
taken to control these bars the public peace
will be affected. Apart from ordering my subor-
dinates to keep a sharp watch on the esta-
blishments I hereby issue this proclamation which
the proprietors of the foreign bars should observe
and carry on their business according to the
conditions. If the proprietor of any of the
establishments is found to commit a breach of
any of the conditions he will be fined or his
license will be withdrawn whereby the establish-
ment will be closed up. This proclamation
must be enforced and all the foreign bars should
not attempt to disobey it otherwise they will
get into trouble".

Conditions.

1 - No foreign bars are permitted to be established
on the border of the Settlement and Chinese
territory.
2 - All foreign bars must close their doors at 12 m.n.
3 - No drunkenness and disturbances are allowed on
the premises nor will singing in loud voice
dancing or noise be permitted.
4 - No gambling, immorality or other improper con-
duct be allowed on the premises.
5 - No meetings, lectures or boxing be permitted
to take place.
6 - On a breach of any of the conditions the
proprietor will be liable to a fine or can-
cellation of license.
7 - Free access should be given to the Police
at all times.
8 - Amendments may afterwards be made to the
conditions.
9 - The conditions will take effect as from
the date of publication.

L. U. BBC

1920年4月18日

上海 - 1900年10月13日。

吴淞与上海警察厅发布通告如下：

“鉴于北四川路和玉宫路（Jukong Road）的外国酒吧不断违反警务规章，本人作为警长，制定了九条管控这些场所的条件。这些条件已印成中英文对照文本，并分发给各酒吧。

本人现发现，部分酒吧依照这些条件经营，而另一些则故意违犯，例如整夜敞开大门并容许滋扰事件发生。若不采取措施管控这些酒吧，公共安宁将受到影响。除命令下属严密监视这些场所外，本人特此发布本公告，外国酒吧业主应遵守并按条件经营。若发现任何场所业主违反任一条件，将被处以罚款或吊销执照，从而导致该场所关闭。本公告必须严格执行，所有外国酒吧不得试图违抗，否则将面临麻烦。”

条件。

1 - 不允许在租界与中国领土交界处设立外国酒吧。
2 - 所有外国酒吧必须在午夜12点关门。
3 - 场所内不允许醉酒和滋扰行为，也不允许高声歌唱、跳舞或制造噪音。
4 - 场所内不允许赌博、伤风败俗或其他不当行为。
5 - 不允许举行集会、讲座或拳击活动。
6 - 若违反任一条件，业主将被处以罚款或吊销执照。
7 - 警察在任何时候均应享有自由进入权。
8 - 日后可能对这些条件进行修订。
9 - 这些条件自公布之日起生效。

ABOLISH THE
TRENCHES

Widely Signed Petition to Military
Governor for Suppression of
an Unsavory Locality.

The following petition calling
for the total and absolute suppres-
sion of 14 cafes, etc., in the local-
ity known as the "Trenches" has
been addressed to Gen. Ho Feng-
lin by residents of Shanghai and
Chapei:—

To H. E. General Ho Feng-Lin,
Military Governor of Shanghai,
Commissioner of Defence for
Shanghai, Sungkiang and
Woosung, Kiangsu Arsenal.
January 17, 1921.
SIR,—We, the undersigned citi-
zens of Shanghai and or residents
of Chapei, irrespective of race, na-
tionality or religion, desire to ex-
press appreciation of your recent
official action in regard to dives
and brothels in various parts of
the city outside of the settlement
limits, and especially the follow-
ing, which are on North Szechuen
and Yukong Roads:—
Yukong Road—10:
Forest Cafe Buffet
Palais Crystal Garden
Rialto Bar
Cafe De Paris
Cafe Venetia
Palermo
Central Cafe
Jew's Criterion Cafe
Scottish Cafe Bar
Eldorado
North Szechuen Road—4:
Shanghai Cafe Grill
Masonic Bar
International Bar
Golden Eagle Bar

We heartily endorse your action
and respectfully and particularly
urge that these 14 dives be all per-
manently closed. All of them we
are informed, are owned by for-
eigners and licensed by the Chapei
Constabulary. They are on or near
the North Szechuen Road, the only
north and south thoroughfare for
a large proportion of Shanghai re-
sidents. A great number of decent
people daily pass these places.
Of these a large proportion
are school children, for the
section of Shanghai served by the
North Szechuen Road has within it
many schools of several national-
ities, including British, American,
Japanese and, particularly, many
Chinese schools. It is estimated
that the Chinese students outnum-
ber the others by something like
six to one.

These saloons are subversive
of morality and stimulants to
evil living, and act as a
powerful means of education
on this large body of growing
youth. It is imperatively necessary
that this educational section of
Shanghai be permanently protected
from these indecent and evil
influences. In addition to pro-
miscuous dancing, drinking and
carousing during all hours of the
day and night at these dens, in-
toxicated men coming therefrom
frequently insult respectable women
and girls passing by and their re-

取缔
战壕区

致军事督军的广泛签名请愿书，要求镇压一个令人厌恶的地区。

以下请愿书呼吁彻底且绝对地取缔被称为“战壕区”（Trenches）地区的14家咖啡馆等场所，已由上海及闸北居民呈递给何丰林将军：—

致上海军事督军、上海松江吴淞防御专员、江苏兵工厂督办何丰林阁下钧鉴：
1921年1月17日。
先生，——我们，下列签署人，系上海市民及/或闸北居民，不分种族、国籍或宗教，谨对您近期针对租界范围以外城市各处下流场所及妓院采取的官方行动表示赞赏，特别是位于北四川路和玉宫路的以下场所：—
玉宫路—10家：
Forest Cafe Buffet（森林咖啡自助餐馆）
Palais Crystal Garden（水晶花园舞厅）
Rialto Bar（里亚尔托酒吧）
Cafe De Paris（巴黎咖啡馆）
Cafe Venetia（威尼斯咖啡馆）
Palermo（巴勒莫）
Central Cafe（中央咖啡馆）
Jew's Criterion Cafe（犹太人标准咖啡馆）
Scottish Cafe Bar（苏格兰咖啡酒吧）
Eldorado（埃尔多拉多）
北四川路—4家：
Shanghai Cafe Grill（上海烧烤咖啡馆）
Masonic Bar（共济会酒吧）
International Bar（国际酒吧）
Golden Eagle Bar（金鹰酒吧）

我们衷心支持您的行动，并恭敬且特别恳请将这14家下流场所全部永久关闭。据我们要知，这些场所均由外国人拥有，并由闸北警察厅颁发执照。它们位于或靠近北四川路，这是上海大部分居民唯一的南北向主干道。大量正派人士每日经过这些地方。其中很大一部分是学龄儿童，因为北四川路所服务的上海区域内容纳了许多各国学校，包括英国、美国、日本学校，以及特别是许多中国学校。据估计，中国学生人数与其他国家学生人数之比约为六比一。

这些酒馆破坏道德，助长邪恶生活，并对这一大批成长中的青年起到强有力的反面教育作用。迫切需要将上海这一教育区域永久保护起来，使其免受这些猥亵和邪恶影响。除了在这些巢穴中日夜不停地发生杂乱跳舞、饮酒和狂欢外，从中出来的醉汉经常侮辱路过的体面妇女和女孩，并且他们的行径……

The North China Daily News. 24-1-1921.
C. I. D.
K. 3572S
No.
Date 26/1/21

displayed by the authorities in dealing with this evil, which has been allowed to grow until it has become a menace to the health and morals of the community, and even life taken as a result of the influence of these places.

In addition to being centres of indecency, they are giving rise to general lawlessness, for if foreign ruffians may thus break the peace with impunity, the Chinese population have a constant and dangerous example which incites them to do likewise.

These places are not generally nor exclusively frequented by Shanghai residents but are "man-traps," in the main, for transient visitors to Shanghai, such as sailors or seafaring men particularly. Prostitutes at times openly ply their trade on the public roads. In short, these places continually disturb the peace and are a constant menace to good government, morals and life.

Furthermore, we would point out that the good names of the officials responsible for permitting these dives to open, is also affected. The American and British authorities are dealing severely with cases of intoxication, disorderly conduct and breaches of the peace committed by their nationals, and for the public welfare it is necessary their efforts be seconded by the Chinese officials, not by sporadically enforced regulations as to the hour of closing at night, but heartily supported in the only vigorous manner that could effectively meet the situation— inexorable abolition.

From every viewpoint, therefore, we again urge that the steps you have taken be made permanently effective.

Very respectfully,

当局在处理这一罪恶时表现出的……（原文此处接上一页末尾，语意连贯为：并且他们的行为……显示出当局在处理这一罪恶时的态度），这种罪恶任其滋长，直至成为社区健康和道德的威胁，甚至因这些场所的影响而夺去生命。

除了是不雅行为的中心外，它们还引发了普遍的无法无天状态，因为如果外国流氓可以如此肆无忌惮地破坏和平，中国民众就会有一个持续且危险的榜样，煽动他们效仿。

光顾这些地方的通常并非完全是上海居民，它们在很大程度上是专为上海 transient visitors（临时访客）设置的“陷阱”，特别是水手或航海人员。妓女有时在公共道路上公然招揽生意。简而言之，这些地方不断扰乱治安，对良政、道德和生命构成持续威胁。

此外，我们要指出，那些负责允许这些下流场所开业的官员的良好声誉也受到影响。美国和英国当局正在严厉处理其国民犯下的醉酒、扰乱秩序和破坏和平案件，为了公共福利，中国官员有必要支持他们的努力，不是通过 sporadically enforced regulations as to the hour of closing at night（零星执行的关于夜间关门时间的规定），而是以唯一能有效应对局面的有力方式给予全心支持——即毫不留情地予以取缔。

因此，从各方面来看，我们再次敦促使您已采取的步骤产生永久效力。

此致
敬礼，
